title: ONI Companion Link: companion/acks/ack-<seq>.json (v1.1, v1.3 commands)
description: Written by the mod (write-tmp-then-rename) after it ran, or refused, cmd-<seq>.json. The core turns it into GET /actions/<seq> and an 'action' event. v1.2 commands (alert_activate, alert_dismiss, set_speed, sync_assets) are acked the same way: alert_activate / alert_dismiss / set_speed after the game call ran (done), or at once failed with a short message ("Alert is gone", "Can't be dismissed", "No colony loaded"); v1.3 commands (overlay_set, tool_select, build_select) are acked after the game call ran (done) or at once failed with the game's reason ("Not researched yet", "Not available in this game", "Not enough Copper"); sync_assets acks at once ("Started"), progress goes to companion/sync/status.json. No ack within 10 s = state expired in the API (the mod never writes 'expired').

message.description: Short, shown to the user, e.g. "Duplicant not found" or "Command too old".
